"Saturday Church" is easy enough for all audiences to respect and pleasing enough to watch.
Saturday Church's story wilts slightly set against its stunning songs.
From the very first thump of the new musical Saturday Church, you can tell that it’s going to become a spiritual successor to Larson’s now classic.
But to those who do know the movie – or the real-life community that inspired it — the musical can feel like overkill.
Saturday Church’s heart is in the right place, but its conventionality overpowers the serene joy that comes with just being around your people.
While the lyrics are too obviously pop driven, often repetitive and failing to advance the story, it’s hard to mind too much because the music is so damn catchy.
But the familiar dance beats and melodic riffs aren’t quite enough to make Saturday Church stand out among identity-focused new works.
